jyutping: jiu3 jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 sin1 V

english.note: Use this when something cannot be seen unless a telescope is used.

examples.english: That star is telescopic and can only be seen with a telescope.
examples.traditional: 嗰粒星要用望遠鏡先睇到。
